cases.description: Positive case: a single image encoded as a data URL on Metal should be correctly described.
Negative case: sending two images is an explicitly unsupported mode; a correct rejection or degradation is a PASS, not a gap.
Negative case: combining image input with a tool/function call is unsupported even though each works alone.
